headline: The model expects Tomato's price to rise by about 14% over 6 days.

groups.title: Seasonal pattern
groups.evidence: In 2 earlier years, Tomato prices changed by +2.1% on average over the 6 days after a September start.

groups.title: Recent trend
groups.evidence: The price fell 52% over the last 30 days and fell 50% over the last 90 days.

groups.title: Compared with last year
groups.evidence: The price was 45% below the same date last year.

groups.title: Supply (arrivals)
groups.evidence: Arrivals over the last 30 days were 6% above the usual September level of earlier years.

groups.title: Market premium
groups.evidence: This market's price was 8% below the Maharashtra median for Tomato on that date (8% above on average over the last 30 days).

confidence.basis: backtest on unseen dates, Tomato, 1-7 days ahead, n=3176
confidence.text: In backtests on unseen dates, Tomato forecasts 1-7 days ahead missed by about ₹394 per quintal (19%) on average and were 2% more accurate than simply keeping the latest price. When the model gave a clear direction it was right 84% of the time.

notes: Contributions describe what the model did with each input; they show association in 2023–2025 data, not proven causes.
